newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shrs end higher, consolidation seen.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shrs end higher, consolidation seen.

text.p: Stocks closed slightly higher on Saturday after fluctuating narrowly on the back of selective buying of theme-backed shares, brokers said.
They said overall sentiment would weaken next week over fears of an economic slowdown.
The composite index ended 1.21 points higher at 785.26.
The positive effects of the plan to expand the foreign shareholding limit, announced on Tuesday, lost steam towards the weekend, brokers said.
"Jitters over economic trouble are likely to haunt the market again next week," said Choo Hee-yup of Dongwon Securities.
